why_ai: Licensed nurses and aides give hands-on care around the clock under federal certification, with demand rising as the population ages.
why_clarity: The MDS and RAI Manual codify assessment and care planning across recurring cases, but whether care was good shows slowly and noisily.
why_digital: Care is delivered in person to residents in a local building that families and hospital case managers choose locally.

why_ai: Reading charts and coding MDS items is screen work that evidence-extraction models target, protected mainly by the coordinator's signature and audit accountability.
why_clarity: The RAI Manual defines every item and look-back window and assessments recur thousands of times, though functional scoring involves judgement and audits arrive months later.
why_digital: Charts, notes and assessments are digital and transmitted electronically, with some resident interviews held on site.

why_ai: Scheduling and shift matching automate well, but the hours being supplied are hands-on clinical labour from people facilities must trust.
why_clarity: Every shift is filled or not and reported to CMS, though who can be relied on to cover a unit is learned by experience.
why_digital: Schedules, offers and payroll are digital, while the delivered service is a clinician physically on the floor of a local building.

why_ai: Call-off forecasting and shift offers are automatable; keeping new aides depends on supervisors and relationships software cannot replace.
why_clarity: Shifts recur daily and fills are instantly checkable, but retention levers vary by unit and supervisor.
why_digital: Timeclock, schedule and texting data drive the work on screens, bought by local facility leaders.

why_ai: Matching and credential checks are software, but facilities still need licensed, reliable people they can trust on a unit.
why_clarity: Each shift is filled within the window or not, with show-up as an instant objective test, thousands of times a day.
why_digital: Offers, credentials and pay run in apps, while the delivered service is a clinician on site.

why_ai: Former surveyors and nurse consultants with regional knowledge defend facilities when certification and stars are at stake.
why_clarity: F-tags and the survey process define requirements, and the real 2567 grades the preparation.
why_digital: Public 2567 data and documents are digital, with mock surveys sometimes held on site.

why_ai: Packet reading and payer checks automate, while hospital-liaison relationships and accepting complex patients keep some protection.
why_clarity: Each referral is accepted or lost within hours at high volume, though whether it was a good admission shows weeks later.
why_digital: Packets arrive by fax and portal and are reviewed on screens; liaisons still visit hospitals.

why_ai: Aides and nurses care hands-on for residents who cannot speak for themselves, where trust and judgement are the product.
why_clarity: Daily routines repeat, but good dementia care is hard to define and its effects on falls and behaviours surface slowly.
why_digital: Care is given in person in the building, chosen locally by families.

why_ai: Monitoring and audit preparation automate, but standalone owners buy from a named consultant they trust.
why_clarity: PDPM, PBJ and survey rules define what to check, though each building's mix of problems differs.
why_digital: Facility data and reports are digital, with consultants visiting the building on site.

why_ai: Drafting updates and appeals from notes is document work LLM agents handle well; peer-to-peer argument keeps a human role.
why_clarity: Each plan's template and criteria are written and updates recur weekly, with approvals and overturns as quick feedback.
why_digital: Portals, faxes and notes are handled entirely on screens, often remotely by outsourcers.

why_ai: Turning payroll and invoices into a specified file is fully automatable, with only the facility's attestation and audit exposure as protection.
why_clarity: A fixed file specification, published rules and quarterly deadlines make correctness objectively checkable.
why_digital: Payroll, timeclock and invoice data in, an XML file to CMS out, all digital.

why_ai: Item-level MDS audit is rule-based chart review that AI coding tools target; consultants keep some protection through audit defence and trust.
why_clarity: The RAI Manual makes every audited item checkable at high volume, with TPE and case-mix outcomes as feedback.
why_digital: Charts in and audit reports out, done remotely for facilities nationwide.

why_ai: Former surveyors' regional knowledge and on-site mock surveys protect the work when certification is at stake.
why_clarity: F-tags and the LTCSP define requirements, and real survey results grade the work.
why_digital: Document review and public 2567 data are digital, with mock surveys held in the building.

why_ai: Rate calculation and record review are automatable, but state contracts and accountable reviewers persist.
why_clarity: State plans and the RAI Manual codify rates and reviews, repeated every quarter across thousands of facilities.
why_digital: MDS and cost data are digital, some reviews are on site, and the work is won through state procurement.

why_ai: Licensed consultant pharmacists review regimens monthly, often on site, and answer personally for their recommendations.
why_clarity: Regimen reviews recur monthly against explicit criteria, though outcomes of dose changes show slowly.
why_digital: Medication records are digital, but reviews and relationships are tied to local facilities.

why_ai: In-product analytics and AI features are software work, protected by platform data share and the HIPAA perimeter.
why_clarity: Features are measurable against product usage and outcome data across thousands of facilities.
why_digital: Clinical records in and software features out, all in code.

why_ai: Validation and star previews are rule-based software functions that AI-native competitors can replicate.
why_clarity: Submission specifications and CMS methods make every check objective and repeatable.
why_digital: Submission files in and validation results out, sold as online subscriptions.

why_ai: Building performance and star analytics are automatable, with acquisition underwriting adding some judgement.
why_clarity: CMS measures and payment rules define targets reported on fixed cycles.
why_digital: Clinical and financial records in, analyses out for internal buyers.

why_ai: An operator contributor network is a data moat AI cannot rebuild, and investors keep paying for trusted market numbers.
why_clarity: Occupancy and revenue-mix metrics are computed the same way every month from contributed data.
why_digital: Contributed data in and subscriptions out, sold nationally online.

why_ai: Rate impact modelling is automatable; advocacy relationships give modest protection.
why_clarity: Annual payment rules recur on fixed calendars, but policy outcomes are slow and contested.
why_digital: Public rule and claims files in, analyses and testimony out.

why_ai: Underwriting operators and properties is high-stakes judgement on relationships and covenants that buyers keep paying people for.
why_clarity: Coverage ratios and covenants are defined, but each deal and turnaround differs and outcomes take years.
why_digital: Tenant financials are digital, but properties are inspected and relationships with operators are local.

why_ai: Pricing and matching models are software work inside the marketplace.
why_clarity: Every shift posting gives instant fill and price feedback at very high volume.
why_digital: Transaction data in and product features out, all in code.

why_ai: Credentialed actuaries sign loss projections that insurers and operators rely on.
why_clarity: Actuarial methods are standard and repeated annually, but claims develop over years.
why_digital: Claims data in and reports out, delivered remotely.

why_ai: Cleaning public PBJ files is automatable; advocacy credibility is the protection.
why_clarity: Quarterly staffing metrics are computed the same way from each release and are easy to check.
why_digital: Public files in and online reports out.

why_ai: Collecting and tabulating pay data is routine work that payroll-data platforms can substitute.
why_clarity: A defined survey instrument produces the same tables every year.
why_digital: Submitted data in and a report out, sold online.

why_ai: Statutory authority and on-site inspection by accountable surveyors keep this work with people.
why_clarity: F-tags and the LTCSP codify the process, and surveys recur on a 15-month cycle, though findings are contested.
why_digital: Surveyors observe residents and care in person; findings are issued as public documents; nobody buys the service.
